answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 17127 Country: India Title: As salamwalikum R/ulemas, I would like ask u that my friend runs the offset printing press,& as per order he print the invitation card, posters,palm lets, which have photos of human beings and hindu gods, pls tell me is it ture & the money earned from it is "halal"? Question: As salamwalikum R/ulemas, I would like ask u that my friend runs the offset printing press,& as per order he print the invitation card, posters,palm lets, which have photos of human beings and hindu gods, pls tell me is it ture & the money earned from it is "halal"? Answer ID: 17127 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 16511651/M=1430) Printing of such posters and pamphlets etc which contain the picture of animals and Hindu gods is makrooh, and its earning is also not pure. Muslims should earn pure halal and clean livelihood. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
